note: cost: opening price in political power, before tensionDiscount. costDoublesAtDistance: the cost rises with the compass distance between the two governments and is doubled at this distance. costDoublesCloser: the cost rises as the two governments' compass points draw together: doubled on the same point, and the listed cost at this distance or further. colonyCost: the same in a colony of the actor's own. dailyCost: political power a day while it is held; with dailyCostDistance, it rises with the compass distance between the two and is doubled at that distance. doubledAboveOwnView: the cost is doubled while the actor's own opinion of the target is above this. claimCost: the cost where the actor claims ground the target holds. tension: world tension the act raises, charged to the actor; tensionWithoutCasusBelli: the same where it is taken without one. notUnderPact: barred while the two hold a non-aggression pact. options: one act, its kind chosen when taken, each kind with its own cost and needs. notByMembers: a realm's member may not take it; its realm does. bindsMembers: when a realm takes it or is its target, every member takes part with it. cooldownDays: days before a country may take it again against the same country. notAgainstOwnVassals: a country may not take it against its own colonies, puppets or other vassals. notByVassals: a colony, puppet or other vassal may not take it against anyone; its suzerain does. notAgainstOwnSuzerain: a vassal may take it, but not against its own suzerain. onlyByMembers: only a realm's member may take it, and only toward its own realm. needs: what must hold for the act to be taken. notAtWar: the two are not at war. relations: the target's opinion of the actor is at least this. relationsAbove: the target's opinion of the actor is above this. relationsWithMembers: every member's opinion of the joiner is at least this. targetAtWar: the target is at war. militaryAllianceOrAccess: the actor is in a military alliance with the target or has military access through it.

tensionDiscount.note: perPoint: political power off the act per point of world tension, floored at floor times the listed cost.

actions.name: Improve relations
actions.effect: opinions of POLITY_NAME on us will improve every day up to a limit of +30. Our opinions on them will improve up to +7.5. When stopped, improvements will decay at 0.027 per day.

actions.name: Denounce
actions.effect: opinions of POLITY_NAME and vice versa drops by 20, decaying at 0.014 per day. POLITY_NAME cannot improve relations with us for 90 days.

actions.name: Guarantee
actions.effect: we will join any war declared on POLITY_NAME. Opinions of POLITY_NAME on us will improve every day up to a limit of +20. Our opinions on them will improve up to +5. If we refuse to join such a war, we will lose 30 stability, recovering 2.5 per month; All our guarantees will end, opinions of POLITY_NAME on us will drop by 40, and the opinions on us of every other country we guarantee will drop by 10.

actions.name: Non-aggression pact
actions.effect: neither party may justify or declare war on the other for an agreed duration. Mutual opinions will improve by 5 while the pact is active. Either party may depart prematurely with a 90-day-notice. If a guarantee or alliance brings the two parties to war with each other, the pact ends. If we leave without notice, the opinions of POLITY_NAME on us will drop by 25.

actions.name: Alliance

options.name: Economic
options.effect: no tariffs are charged on members of the same alliance. Each member has +15% importable shortfall. If members are at war with each other, their membership is suspended until peace.

options.name: Technological
options.effect: each member gains 10% of the other members' research points. A technology one member has researched costs other members 25% less. If members are at war with each other, their membership is suspended until peace.

options.name: Military
options.effect: members join mutual members' wars. Members may not declare war on each other.

actions.effect: Establishes a new alliance of the chosen kind, or joins an existing one. A country may belong to any number of alliances.

actions.name: Leave an alliance
actions.effect: we leave the alliance. If it is a military alliance at war, the opinions of every member on us drop by 40.

actions.name: Request military access
actions.effect: our divisions may cross the territory of POLITY_NAME. POLITY_NAME may withdraw access at any time, and our opinions on them will then drop by 25.

actions.name: Sanction
actions.effect: there will be no trading with POLITY_NAME while the sanctions are active. Opinions of POLITY_NAME on us drop by 30.

actions.name: State agreement
actions.effect: we and POLITY_NAME can exchange goods.

actions.name: Development aid
actions.effect: we may build one level of infrastructure in a province, or a rail in a county, in POLITY_NAME, at our expense. Upkeep will be payed by us until responsibility is handed over. For each infrastructure level or railway we pay upkeep on, opinions of POLITY_NAME on us improve by 2, up to a limit of +15. Our opinions on them will improve up to +3.75

actions.name: Lease deposit
actions.effect: POLITY_NAME will extract resources from an agreed number of deposits for a set duration and pay us rent.

actions.name: Request deposit lease
actions.effect: asks POLITY_NAME to lease us an agreed number of deposits in a particular province for a set duration, for rent.

actions.name: Send volunteers
actions.effect: up to 3 of our divisions will fight under the command of POLITY_NAME without us going to war. Opinions of POLITY_NAME on us will improve by 10. Opinions of every country at war with POLITY_NAME on us will drop by 25

actions.name: Expeditionary force
actions.effect: our divisions come under the full command of POLITY_NAME

actions.name: Justify war
actions.effect: gives us a casus belli against POLITY_NAME for one year.

actions.name: Declare war
actions.effect: we go to war with POLITY_NAME.

actions.name: Ask for diplomatic action
actions.effect: asks our realm or federation to take a particular action against a named country.
